name: Personal Finance
description: Mortgage, savings, loan, tax, and investment calculators.
longDescription: Working out whether you can afford a mortgage, how fast you can pay off a loan, or what your investments might be worth in twenty years shouldn't require downloading an app or handing over your financial details. These calculators run the numbers right in your browser — amortization schedules, compound interest projections, freelance tax estimates, and more. Every formula is based on standard financial models, and the results are shown alongside the maths so you can check the working yourself. Nothing you enter leaves your device.

name: Business Metrics
description: CAC, LTV, churn, CPM, lease tax savings, and profit estimation.
longDescription: If you've ever stared at a spreadsheet trying to figure out your customer acquisition cost or whether that novated lease actually saves you tax, these tools are for you. They cover the core metrics founders and finance teams work with day to day — CAC, LTV, churn, CPM, SaaS ratios, FBA profit margins. The formulas are drawn from standard business and accounting practices, and each tool shows its working so you can verify the output. Everything runs locally, so sensitive revenue and cost figures stay on your machine.

name: Maths & Numbers
description: General-purpose maths tools, percentage calculators, and number puzzles.
longDescription: Sometimes you just need a quick percentage calculation, or you want to explore the digits of Pi, or you're curious about Kaprekar's constant. These tools handle the everyday maths that comes up at work, school, or just out of curiosity — percentage changes, number base conversions, and a few recreational maths puzzles. The calculations are straightforward and the results are instant. No accounts, no tracking, no fuss.

name: Converters
description: Unit converters, colour converters, format converters and more.
longDescription: Converting between units shouldn't feel like a chore. These converters cover length, weight, volume, temperature, pressure, energy, force, power, angle, fuel efficiency, density, and thermal properties — all using standardised conversion factors with proper attention to precision and edge cases. Whether you're converting PSI to bar for an engineering spec or Celsius to Fahrenheit for a recipe, the results are instant and the maths is visible. No server calls, no data collection, just straight conversion.

name: Health Tools
description: Health calculators and estimators for BMI, calories, hydration, and more.
longDescription: Health calculators are useful when you want a quick estimate without booking an appointment. These tools cover BMI, basal metabolic rate, calorie deficits, hydration needs, and fertility window estimates — all based on published formulas and standard medical ranges. They're not a substitute for professional advice, but they give you a starting point for understanding your own numbers. Everything stays in your browser; no health data is stored or transmitted.

name: Web Tools
description: Tools for developers and designers — colour, text, encoding, and more.
longDescription: Building for the web means constantly juggling formats, encoding strings, checking headers, and tweaking CSS. These tools handle the small but frequent tasks that slow you down — colour palette generation, compression analysis, password hashing, meta tag previewing, htaccess and nginx redirect building. Each tool is focused on one job and does it quickly. No sign-ups, no server round-trips, no waiting.

name: Text Processing
description: Tools to clean, convert, and transform text data instantly.
longDescription: Whether you're tidying up a CSV export, converting markdown to HTML, deduplicating a list, or just trying to figure out why your JSON won't parse, these text tools get it done. They handle whitespace cleanup, case conversion, delimiter swapping, column extraction, and a range of other string transformations. Paste your text in, pick the operation, and copy the result. Everything runs in your browser, so sensitive data never leaves your machine.

name: AI Web Tools
description: Client-side AI workflow and prompt engineering utilities.
longDescription: Working with large language models means spending a lot of time on prompt design, token counting, and output formatting. These tools help with the practical side of that workflow — tokenising prompts, building prompt chains, checking for hallucinations, stress-testing safety filters, and formatting structured data for model input. Everything runs client-side, so your prompts and API keys never touch a server.

name: PDF Tools
description: Merge, split, compress, convert, and edit PDF files in your browser.
longDescription: PDF manipulation usually means uploading your files to some random website and hoping they don't keep a copy. These tools do everything in your browser — merging, splitting, rotating, reversing pages, OCR, editing, signing, converting to and from PDF, and optimising file size. The processing happens entirely client-side using PDF.js and related libraries, so your documents never leave your device.

name: Lexical Tools
description: Word games, anagram finders, vocabulary tools, and language puzzles.
longDescription: Language is more fun when you can play with it. These tools help you find anagrams, generate placeholder text, count words and characters, and explore word patterns. Whether you're stuck on a crossword, building a word game, or just curious about what words can be made from a set of letters, these tools give you instant results. No accounts, no data collection, just words.

name: Randomizers
description: Shuffle lists, draw winners, generate random values, and more.
longDescription: Randomness is surprisingly useful — picking a winner, shuffling a playlist, generating a passphrase, simulating dice rolls, or just making a decision when you can't choose. These tools use cryptographic randomness (via the Web Crypto API) to ensure fair, unpredictable results. Whether you need a coin flip, a random number in a range, or a shuffled list, the result is instant and verifiable. Nothing is stored or transmitted.
